description: This file contains a PHP trait 'EndpointRegionHelperTrait' that provides helper methods for handling AWS S3 endpoint regions, including functions for determining partition suffixes, signing regions, matching regions, and validating FIPS configurations and region consistency. It is used internally for AWS SDK's S3 endpoint region logic.

methods.name: getPartitionSuffix
methods.description: Returns the DNS suffix for a given ARN's partition, utilizing the partition provider.

methods.name: getSigningRegion
methods.description: Determines the appropriate signing region for a given region and service, consulting the partition data.

methods.name: isMatchingSigningRegion
methods.description: Checks whether the ARN's region matches the client's region or the signing region derived from the partition data.

methods.name: validateFipsConfigurations
methods.description: Validates whether FIPS configurations are compatible with the ARN and current region settings, throwing exceptions if not.

methods.name: validateMatchingRegion
methods.description: Validates that the ARN's region matches the client's region or the derived signing region, throwing an exception if not.
